sloka: ऋषि वाटाः च दृश्यन्ते शकटी शत संकुलाः ।देशो विधीयताम् ब्रह्मन् यत्र वत्स्यामहे वयम् ॥१-५०-४॥
transliteration: ṛṣi vāṭāḥ ca dṛśyante śakaṭī śata saṁkulāḥ ।deśo vidhīyatām brahman yatra vatsyāmahe vayam ॥1-50-4॥

translations.english: O Illustrious sage thousands of brahmins living in different countries and versed in the study of the vedas have assembled here. The shelters for ascetics are thronged with hundreds of carts. O Great ascetic let us choose a place where we can stay.
